world.label: Dystopian Classic Literature
world.engineRationale: Ray Bradbury's Fahrenheit 451 explores psychological numbness, sensory overload, and the voluntary surrender of thought. Antidote's expressive vector rigs, emotion overlays (fire, question, shock, sweat), cinematic shadow sets (dim parlor walls, night streets, campfire woods), and symbolic motifs (book, door, crack, clock, counter) deliver maximum thematic impact and clarity.
